purpose: P023 independent local person/book/method library, archival sources and manually written method versions

storage.policy: dedicated DB only; append immutable versions; no destructive delete or schema reset

subjects.manualReview: nonempty user-supplied basis; never independent confirmation

sources.text: complete original text/content/transcript joined by two newlines; no clipping
sources.importIdentity: explicit channelKey plus observation id or externalKey; full observation fingerprint yields immutable version
sources.manualRevision: explicit source editing saves new version; earlier original source and all its fields remain in history

methods.subjectRef: full validated person-method/subjects version; current rename never rebinds existing method

assessment.quoteMatched: literal substring of supplied full source record body; not attribution, efficacy or performance validation

versionDescriptor.identity: id equals originalRecord.id; full-record SHA256 using shared canonical encoding; no title/name/code fallback
versionDescriptor.location: own immutable ID+full record equality, or external descriptor equality plus root target draft guard; frozen originals remain readable after source changes

canonical.strings: minimal JSON escapes, UTF-8, no slash escaping
canonical.numbers: tagged IEEE754 64-bit bits, negative zero normalized; finite magnitude <= 9007199254740991; larger exact values must be strings
canonical.revision: SHA256 of full record excluding recordRevision

import.legacy: preserve parent metadata and all observation/commentData/backtest/unknown fields; keep old source roles, confidence and marketing as claims; no same-name merge
import.preview: show counts, object/type/identity/provenance, source original role/time/length/fingerprint, method frozen references and conflicts; no database writes
import.confirm: transaction with full preview baseline comparison; exact duplicates skipped, same-ID conflicts keep existing; stale preview rejected
import.cancel: clear pending preview and leave database untouched

drafts: per-store atomic private sidecar; complete original baselines, unsaved values, frozen refs, filter state and pending preview; Bundle/QJsonObject contains same-store file marker only; stale drafts refuse overwrite; theme/search/navigation never autosave a business record
archive: optional boolean archived; explicit archive appends a version; originals remain readable and exported
boundary: no remote AI requests, orders, stock picks, model/backtest verification, production DB migration, shared host edits or automatic author attribution
